STATUS: ANSWER
The only gene panel in the results is HBOC-panel, which contains BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2 and TP53 [graph#1]. The results do not explain how gene panels are used in filtering. The hard-filtering text describes pre-defined thresholds on variant annotations such as allele depth and mapping quality [sarek_vc_theory#h008], but does not link these thresholds to any panel. I cannot explain panel-based filtering from the available results.
